values.review_scope: Review #341 changed harness, validator, tests, evidence, feature projection, C-SDLC cards, and private Observatory demo truth. Reject credential leaks, fixture-only substitution, provider-specific overfitting, stale prerequisite truth, public exposure claims, or ownership drift into #256, #414, Observatory public deployment, GPU quota, or Runtime architecture.
review_prompts: Does the implementation prove the same scenario through at least two approved real providers without fixture/cached substitution?
Are credentials, private prompts, and raw provider payloads excluded from tracked artifacts and logs?
Do negative cases produce visible non-pass outcomes rather than being skipped or converted to success?
Does one provider failure leave Runtime and unrelated agents available?
Is the Observatory demonstration private and non-production, with no public exposure overclaim?
Are all changed paths within #341 ownership and free of #256/#414 implementation drift?
